interfaces.installed_runner: Runs the installed relative exec/triomics launcher in executable A, B, C, D, and report order against the same materialized config and reads producer outputs through the existing report bundle consumer.
interfaces.wrapper_manifest: Records byte-bound input/config/output references, installed package identity, source revision, and authoritative packet/requirement/ledger file hashes. Execution status, synthetic software evidence, scientific validation, packet acceptance, and publication remain separate fields.
interfaces.programme_reconciliation: Supplied authoritative identities are validated as complete, unique, and cross-referenced. Counts and sorted-identity hashes are recorded while final packet/requirement/conditional acceptance reconciliation remains pending Sol; no all-accepted roster is embedded.
interfaces.missingness_and_clinical: Not exercised by this packet's paired/independent result fixtures. Sol's merged installed clinical smoke should use the accepted D-T15 materializer, include the approved placeholder token in a measurement, and verify the complete-case clinical exclusion read-back.

verification_evidence.installed_restart_contract: The test invokes triomics_export_a(request, output, resume=TRUE, interrupt='feature:prot') in a clean installed subprocess, then checks partial-payload recovery, full checkpoint reuse, block-local source invalidation, and seed/configuration/version invalidation.

acceptance.scientific_claims: Public synthetic software evidence only; no biological, clinical, or real-data validation is established.

integration_request: No shared CLI, stage registry, namespace, schema, specification, or ledger change is requested. Sol owns integration, final programme reconciliation, packet acceptance, and milestone acceptance.
